questions.stemHtml: A 24-year-old woman is in a car accident and is taken to an emergency room, where she receives x-ray examina ons of her neck, chest, and lower spine. options.label: A

options.label: B

options.label: C
options.text: At 10 weeks, the fetus is particularly susceptible to derangements of the central nervous system (CNS).

options.label: D
options.text: The fetus has received less than the assumed threshold for radiation damage.
